references.notes: Outer rounded presentation frame omitted; user identity and existing avatar deliberately differ.
Top presentation whitespace omitted; Mashal logo and actual company fields retained.

Accounting role mapping is the actual product configuration; there are no editable FIFO, tax or inventory-accounting-system fields. These are intentional domain differences, not an exact R03 form clone.
Only the annotation stroke is masked, never its interior. Existing single transaction model and supported cash/bank/sarraf methods retained.
Domain widgets use genuine dashboard model: activities, tank inventory, operational alerts; no invented bank/debtor balances.
Modal options map to six real dashboard sections, persisted per user/browser. No cheques feature is invented.
Existing invoice-linked subflow only. Capturing requires an actual test sale; never a new duplicate route.

mask_policy: Mask only educational stroke pixels and the outside frame. No blanket content, spacing, controls or sidebar masks. Domain differences are documented; raw differences are retained without similarity claims.
font: IRANSans already shipped by repository; identity of raster reference font is unproven. JPEG-derived geometry has compression/scaling uncertainty.
